validation: Every process final output hash matches the same-resolution baseline. This does not check every intermediate frame or certify gameplay quality.
whole_frame_method: Matched RGBA16F color/RG16F zero-motion fixture, full eight blocks, one pass, D3D12 debug on both; GPU inference excludes input uploads/output readback. Four processes per route, balanced PNNPNPPN order; separate per-dispatch attribution runs.
clock_method: Observed with nvidia-smi at 100 ms; not locked. Clock samples are restricted by UTC timestamps inside the measured frame window; raw telemetry also retains startup.
dispatch_attribution: Two fresh processes per route/resolution, 256 frames, discard128; timestamps around each launch. Vendor API observed locally in the offline process, no on-disk DLL changes. 154 core launches matched by ordinal/grid/block. Vendor helper clear/copy are reported separately. Matching geometry does not prove identical machine code.
instrumentation_limit: Per-launch queries can change overlap and pacing. Use uninstrumented whole-frame trials for speed claims; sums of kernel medians are diagnostic and need not equal a whole-frame median.
hardware_counter_limit: Nsight GPU hardware metrics were blocked by driver counter permissions. A standard Nsight trace exposed command-list workloads but no CUDA kernel records. No memory-bandwidth, cache-miss, spill-traffic or instruction-throughput diagnosis is claimed.

difference_fit.scope: Descriptive fit to four whole-frame differences; not causal decomposition, an uncertainty bound or a new-resolution prediction.
